name: issei-plugin
description: Issei's personal Claude Code setup. Vault skills (search-vault, distil-vault, lint-vault, challenge-vault, research-vault, weekly-vault-review), pipeline / cadence skills (harvest - weekly knowledge-base harvest with co-located Python scripts; standup-update - daily standup from Claude Code sessions plus GitHub PRs), voice / doc skills (issei-voice for short-form chat, blog-voice for long-form technical writing, exec-summary for condensing spikes and PoCs into tight outcome docs), and meeting-agenda. Pure filesystem, no MCP. meeting-agenda and exec-summary are user-invocable; the rest fire on intent. drawio-diagrams and skill-creator dropped in 0.3.0; covered by the team plugin.
